display_name: 扩大源数据覆盖的 DURA 七景测试
description: 冻结 DURA，独立训练多尺度修正；将训练源记录由 8192 扩至 32768，比较数据覆盖增加的影响。

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen source-only DURA v1.0; fresh independently initialized zero-head multiscale correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA source-only provenance checked by frozen_dura; 32768 fit IDs sampled only from matching source L_s/U_s after held-out exclusions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA source-only with matching data contract and no target ancestry; correction independently initialized
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 5; no source or target performance selection

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent

rows.method: Fresh multiscale DURA correction using ordinary DURA-guard IQ loss and 32768 source IDs
rows.purpose: Complete seven-view Phase1 test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Correction seed 2026110612, source fit seed 2026110611, order seed 2026110613; fixed DURA seed 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views

notes: Source-only L_s/U_s IQ; no TX labels, F weights or outputs, V or target; selected 32768 records from eligible source using fixed seed 2026110611 after held-out RX/day and pilot exclusions.
Ordinary DURA-guard IQ objective, fresh correction seed 2026110612, source ordering seed 2026110613; DURA is frozen.

Three fixed simulated views per record, five epochs, batch 32, AdamW learning rate 0.0003 weight decay 0.001; four times the source exposure and optimizer updates of the 8192-ID five-epoch control, so training cost is not matched.
DURA source contexts are freshly prepared on GPU and saved in the unique run root for reuse; account for all preparation and cache creation costs.
Fixed final epoch without source or target score selection; all seven 168000-record Phase1 views predicted before independent truth-last scoring with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
